{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Cover'' me, Sergeant, while I&mdash;''"<br />"''I respectfully ''disobey'', sir...! This is the job I was ''bred'' for!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Thill|<ref name="Downhill" />}}
'''Thill''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Today, we lost another good man.''"<br />"''It's so ''sad'' about the sergeant. We'll ''always'' remember him!''"<br />"''Yes, child&hellip; And everything he ''fought'' for.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Kralla]], on Thill's sacrifice|<ref name="Downhill" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Thill accompanied [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on a [[Mission to Felucia (Skywalker and Kenobi)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], and on arrival near the world, Thill detected a transmission from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Felucia Separatist base|base]] on the world that revealed that the Separatists were about to fire on the [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|Jedi light cruiser]]. Thill and the two Jedi transferred to a [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|smaller vessel]] moments before the Separatists destroyed their [[Transport/Legends|transport]], and they headed to the planet's surface. Intending to destroy the Separatist installation, the trio trekked through the Felucian jungles in the direction of the base, and a light on Thill's [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] attracted wild creatures, which attacked the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]].<ref name="Downhill" />

After defeating the creatures, the trio resumed their mission, and on arrival at the base they affixed several [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing transmitters]] to the structure, so as to enable a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to fire on the facility. However, after setting up the transmitters, Thill and the Jedi encountered a band of abandoned children who lived in the vicinity of the base. To avoid the children coming to harm from the Republic bombardment, the trio took the children back with them to their transport, and when they arrived at the ship Thill gave the [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] child [[Kralla]] his [[trooper torch]], claiming that it was lucky. Moments later, the transport fell under attack from a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], who attempted to prevent it from taking off. Disobeying a direct order from Kenobi, Thill jumped down from the vessel to hold back the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] while the Jedi and the children escaped aboard the ship. Thill then [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the subsequent bombardment of the Separatist base.<ref name="Downhill" />
